name: image_gen
description: Generate images from a text prompt via an OpenAI-compatible images endpoint (config: media.image). Returns saved artifact path(s) under the workspace outputs dir. Requires MEDIA_IMAGE_* configuration (设置面板媒体模型区).

prompt.description: 画面描述（必填）——写具体：主体/风格/构图/光线，中文英文均可

size.description: 图片尺寸（如 1024x1024），缺省用端点默认

model.description: 模型名，缺省用 media.image.model 配置

name: video_submit
description: Submit an async text-to-video task (config: media.video, first of the two-step submit/poll flow). Returns a task_id immediately; query progress with video_poll. Requires MEDIA_VIDEO_* configuration (设置面板媒体模型区).

prompt.description: 视频内容描述（必填）——主体/动作/镜头运动写具体

model.description: 模型名，缺省用 media.video.model 配置

name: video_poll
description: Poll a submitted video task by task_id (second of the two-step flow). status=succeeded returns the saved video artifact path; running means wait 20-60s and poll again; failed returns the reason. Requires MEDIA_VIDEO_* configuration (设置面板媒体模型区).

task_id.description: video_submit 返回的任务 id（必填）
